With a viewport of `500x300`, the node `root>lower` is located at `y=700` with height `40`, so vertical scrolling can move the viewport down until the entire `y=700..740` range is visible.

In contrast, `root>sideways` is at `x=0` but has `width=900`, so it extends across `x=0..900` while the viewport only spans `x=0..500`. Ordinary (vertical) scrolling cannot change the horizontal span, so it cannot be brought fully into view that way.

ANSWER: root>sideways
